# University of Padua Research Repository

> A comprehensive research repository documenting scholarly work on nonprofit law, comparative legal frameworks, and third-sector regulation across European jurisdictions.

The University of Padua Research Repository (research.unipd.it) serves as a digital archive for academic research and institutional publications. This collection focuses on legal analysis and comparative law studies, particularly examining nonprofit sector regulations and economic frameworks across different countries.

## Key Topics

- Nonprofit law
- Third-sector regulation
- Comparative law
- Economic activity in nonprofits
- Profit distribution
- Belgium
- Italy
- Code des Sociétés et des Associations
- Codice del Terzo Settore
- Legal analysis
- University of Padua

## Comparative Nonprofit Law

- [Economic Activity and Profit Distribution in the Nonprofit Sector: A Comparison between the Belgian Code des Sociétés et des Associations and the Italian Codice del Terzo Settore](https://www.research.unipd.it/handle/11577/3566788): Legal analysis comparing Belgian and Italian nonprofit sector regulations and profit distribution frameworks, examining how different European jurisdictions regulate economic activity and resource allocation in third-sector organizations.
